The '''M-110 Pulse-Wave Disruptor''' was a type of [[Pulse-wave blaster|pulse-wave]] [[Disruptor/Legends|disruptor]] [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]] produced during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
